name: GERA
rootCause: The security of the GERA token was compromised due to private key leakage. Hackers transferred the ownership of the smart contract deployer of GERA tokens to another address 0x510E4d61663bE6a24D600AaF90F892dd8c8C61dC.

descriptions.text: The security of the GERA token was compromised due to private key leakage. Hackers transferred the ownership of the smart contract deployer of GERA tokens to another address 0x510E4d61663bE6a24D600AaF90F892dd8c8C61dC.

On 7 September 2022, GERA's deployer key was compromised on Ethereum, allowing attackers to mint and transfer large volumes of tokens. This led to a reported loss of approximately $1.48 million and a 96+% collapse in token value. Some compensation and contract swap actions were initiated by the MEXC exchange, but no technical recovery was made on-chain. GERA's deployer private key was compromised, giving attackers unrestricted administrative permissions including minting and transfer. This destroyed protocol security boundaries and enabled extraction of value through unauthorized token operations.
